working: With cylinder radius \(r\) and half-height \(h\), the inscribing condition is \(r^2+h^2=R^2\). Volume \(V=\pi r^2(2h)=2\pi(R^2-h^2)h\); \(\frac{dV}{dh}=2\pi(R^2-3h^2)=0\Rightarrow h=R/\sqrt3\) (and \(V''<0\), a maximum).
